title: Computation under rapidly vanishing force in one fixed spatial box
exact_target: For each fixed positive computable viscosity, can every machine and input be effectively encoded into a smooth body force supported for all times in one fixed compact box of $R^3$, so that every mixed derivative decays faster than every inverse power of time, the zero-data Navier–Stokes solution has the same support and decay, is globally smooth and unique in the stated finite-interval energy class with zero pressure, and the material trajectory from the origin crosses $x_1<-1$ exactly on halting?
